name: Courrt
description: Courrt is a research tool for Indian case law. It searches the full corpus of Supreme Court (~35,000) and High Court (~17 million) judgments plus ~36,000 central and state statutes, returning verbatim text from official court PDFs with neutral and law-report citations and a source URL for verification. Hybrid keyword-plus-semantic search supports filtering by court, date, case type, statute/section and disposition, with proximity and synonym-aware queries. Every judgment carries editorial catchwords and the acts it turns on. Fidelity is core: nothing is paraphrased as fact without the underlying text.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Courrt to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Courrt to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.courrt.com/mcp.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Courrt MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Courrt provides these MCP tools: search_judgments, get_judgment, lookup_citation, list_courts, search_legal_documents, get_legal_document, list_document_types, search, fetch, and suggest.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Courrt?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Courrt in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Courrt does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
Courrt is developed by Superlinear Technologies Private Limited. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
